vd-01 MEASURED PHYSICS the rebinding must respect: ignition commit (launch struct created, ship physically departing) is NOT observable from unprotected state — the launch struct is ShipController-local, ship position is not in the spaceFlight snapshot, and raw phase stays 'surface' through the powered climb to LAUNCH_ALTITUDE (~1.4 s in movie). The only readable mid-beat physical edge before the exit fact is the raw phase transition surface->descent (the leave-warp boundary, ~2.0 s before deep_space). Total entry-to-exit air time is ~3.4 s on the chained movie route; three captions (reveal times 3.2/2.2/2.0 s at 34 ms/char) can never each hold a full slot inside it at movie pace. The repair therefore binds the lines to a paced ladder anchored on the player's committed acts, with the one physical edge as accelerator, and an explicit drop rule protecting the frozen exit-window table.

vd-01 BINDING SPEC (all triggers in emergentStoryDirector.ts from unprotected state; strings frozen, bytes unchanged; exit-window cadence table untouched): (1) L1 unchanged — first stable dwelled 'surface-flight'. (2) NEW named constants CH8_L1_MIN_SLOT_SECONDS = 4.5 (94 chars x 34 ms ~= 3.2 s reveal + 1.3 s read) and CH8_L2_MIN_SLOT_SECONDS = 3.0 (66 chars ~= 2.2 s + 0.8 s). (3) L2 fires at min(t_L1 + 4.5, t_phaseEdge) where t_phaseEdge is the live raw getSpaceFlightSnapshot().phase edge from 'surface' to any non-surface value with controlMode 'flight', observed across consecutive director ticks — i.e. the seated self-order after the pond line's slot ('hold it.' as the order given before/as the thumb commits), accelerated to the edge if the player commits first. A player-act acceleration MAY interrupt L1 mid-reveal: this is the single authored exception to the no-mid-reveal-overwrite law, permitted only because it is player-caused (the act interrupts the thought), and it must be asserted as such in tests. (4) L3 fires at max(t_phaseEdge, t_L2 + 3.0), only if strictly before the first deep_space observation. (5) DROP RULE: any L-line unfired when the deep_space fact lands is dropped for that run — nothing queues or defers into the frozen exit window; L4 fires at +0.0 unconditionally; if the exit lands during L3's reveal, the frozen table wins and the truncation is authored. Drops/truncations are authored fast-path degradations (movie chained: L3 drops; deep-link movie: L3 marginal; POTATO per vd-03: L3 drops), asserted in tests, and the full three-line experience is the manual-pace guarantee. (6) SEEDING: all three latches are edge-triggered and seeded at beat entry — on an entry whose phase is already non-surface (mid-flight snapshot restore), L1/L2/L3 seed as consumed; no replay, no catch-up burst; the pristine ?story=ch8-launch deep link boots on the pad (phase 'surface') and plays the full ladder.
